[
  {"id":"r01","class":"extension","alt":null,"reason":"An idempotent external receiver is conditional additional scope beyond the requested reassignment and escalation behavior."},
  {"id":"r02","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It records the delivered working tree and entry command without identifying unfinished work."},
  {"id":"r03","class":"person","alt":"debt","reason":"A person must play the delivered game in a real browser, while the unexercised branches also leave minor test debt."},
  {"id":"r04","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It preserves operational knowledge and constraints for a future greeting change; no current action remains."},
  {"id":"r05","class":"person","alt":null,"reason":"The local player must click a cell and inspect the displayed scoring and ship information."},
  {"id":"r06","class":"decision","alt":"extension","reason":"It explicitly asks whether to add external delivery and permit broader exposure, treating relay implementation as a separate work item."},
  {"id":"r07","class":"extension","alt":null,"reason":"Performance validation is conditional on larger outbox workloads beyond those explicitly specified."},
  {"id":"r08","class":"capability","alt":"person","reason":"The outstanding verification requires authenticated Lightning access, though the observation instruction could also mean a manual browser check."},
  {"id":"r09","class":"capability","alt":null,"reason":"The checks are explicitly deferred to a later run able to open the deployed Lightning interface."},
  {"id":"r10","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It declares feature work complete and records regression checks for future changes."},
  {"id":"r11","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It declares requested behavior complete and records that external relay integration was excluded."},
  {"id":"r12","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It records a convention for a future PR without requesting a current version or changelog change."},
  {"id":"r13","class":"capability","alt":"person","reason":"Rendering and interaction verification needs authenticated browser access; the wording also supports a manual confirmation."},
  {"id":"r14","class":"debt","alt":null,"reason":"Retaining an existing throwaway browser check as an opt-in test is a small test-maintenance task."},
  {"id":"r15","class":"person","alt":"capability","reason":"It explicitly assigns manual verification to a person and offers a later browser-driver run as an alternative."},
  {"id":"r16","class":"extension","alt":"note","reason":"A comprehensive theme and viewport audit exceeds the specified UI checks; the sentence could also simply record an omission."},
  {"id":"r17","class":"person","alt":"debt","reason":"The main handoff requires a user's manual accessibility checks, alongside a concrete README correction and future process guidance."},
  {"id":"r18","class":"person","alt":"extension","reason":"Stopping the leftover server by hand is unconditional; the tests, expiry policy and documentation proposals are explicitly optional."},
  {"id":"r19","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It records the starting revision, return procedure and receipt evidence for conditional future changes."},
  {"id":"r20","class":"capability","alt":null,"reason":"The sole remaining check requires a Windows host to verify platform-specific output bytes."},
  {"id":"r21","class":"capability","alt":"person","reason":"A later run needs headed, authenticated Lightning access, with the machine operator assigned verification if another login is necessary."},
  {"id":"r22","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It records configurable ship names and opt-in browser tests, explicitly leaving nothing else open."},
  {"id":"r23","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It explicitly closes product follow-up and preserves output and testing requirements for future edits."},
  {"id":"r24","class":"decision","alt":null,"reason":"The requester must resolve numeric-format acceptance and the exit behavior for missing arguments."},
  {"id":"r25","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It records a return-procedure constraint that applies only if a later run wants a fast-forward."},
  {"id":"r26","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It declares product work complete and preserves metadata and permission information for possible removal."},
  {"id":"r27","class":"note","alt":null,"reason":"It explicitly states there is no pending task and records behaviors future changes must preserve."},
  {"id":"r28","class":"person","alt":"decision","reason":"The handoff requires a requester answer and an operations readiness confirmation; the delivery question could also represent an unresolved scope decision."},
  {"id":"r29","class":"extension","alt":null,"reason":"Additional coverage and production validation are conditional on promotion beyond the requested Developer Edition deployment."},
  {"id":"r30","class":"capability","alt":null,"reason":"It explicitly requires a later runner capable of activating a control and holding a response."},
  {"id":"r31","class":"extension","alt":null,"reason":"Responsive dark-theme validation is conditional additional scope absent from the request."},
  {"id":"r32","class":"person","alt":null,"reason":"It explicitly requires a person to open the deployed app and confirm its board and controls; the commit location is background knowledge."}
]
